organization.name: Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)
organization.motto: बलस्य मूलं विज्ञानम् (Strength's Origin is in Science)
organization.parent_ministry: Ministry of Defence, Government of India
organization.chairman_role: Secretary, Department of Defence R&D and Chairman, DRDO
organization.overview: DRDO is the premier R&D wing of the Ministry of Defence, armed with a network of over 50 laboratories working across aeronautics, armaments, electronics, combat vehicles, engineering systems, missiles, advanced computing, life sciences, and naval systems.

clusters.focus: Design, development, and strategic deployment of missile systems, rocket propellants, guidance avionics, and hypersonic flight technologies.

laboratories.name: Defence Research and Development Laboratory
laboratories.specialization: Design & development of tactical and strategic missile systems.

laboratories.name: Research Centre Imarat
laboratories.specialization: Pioneer lab in missile avionics, inertial navigation systems, and terminal seekers.

laboratories.name: Advanced Systems Laboratory
laboratories.specialization: Solid propellant rocket motors, carbon-composite structures, and strategic long-range systems.

clusters.focus: Advanced radar systems, electronic warfare (EW) suites, tactical communications, lasers, and electro-optics.

laboratories.name: Electronics and Radar Development Establishment
laboratories.specialization: Design and development of advanced radar and sensor systems for Army, Air Force, and Navy.

laboratories.name: Defence Electronics Research Laboratory
laboratories.specialization: Electronic Warfare systems, SIGINT, COMINT, and radar jamming technologies.

laboratories.name: Defence Electronics Applications Laboratory
laboratories.specialization: Tactical communication systems, millimeter-wave technologies, and SATCOM.

clusters.focus: Fighter aircraft technologies, UAVs, airborne surveillance, aero-engines, and target aircraft.

laboratories.name: Aeronautical Development Establishment
laboratories.specialization: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), flight control systems, and flight simulators.

laboratories.name: Gas Turbine Research Establishment
laboratories.specialization: Design and development of aero gas turbine engines for military aircraft.

laboratories.name: Centre for Airborne Systems
laboratories.specialization: Design, integration, and evaluation of airborne surveillance and command systems.

clusters.focus: Tanks, armored vehicles, artillery guns, high explosives, rocketry, and infantry weapons.

laboratories.name: Combat Vehicles Research and Development Establishment
laboratories.specialization: Tracked and wheeled combat vehicles, automotive systems, and tank transmissions.

laboratories.name: Armament Research and Development Establishment
laboratories.specialization: Conventional armament, small arms, tank guns, and artillery systems.

laboratories.name: High Energy Materials Research Laboratory
laboratories.specialization: Research on high energy formulations, propellants, explosives, and pyrotechnics.

clusters.focus: Sonar systems, underwater weapons, torpedoes, naval stealth, and strategic defense metallurgy.

laboratories.name: Naval Physical and Oceanographic Laboratory
laboratories.specialization: Underwater surveillance, sonar systems, and oceanographic research.

laboratories.name: Naval Science and Technological Laboratory
laboratories.specialization: Underwater weapons, warship hydrodynamics, stealth technology, and mines.

laboratories.name: Defence Metallurgical Research Laboratory
laboratories.specialization: Advanced metallurgical research, high-temperature alloys, and armor materials.

clusters.focus: Human engineering, high-altitude physiology, bio-defense, combat rations, and aviation medicine.

laboratories.name: Defence Bioengineering and Electromedical Laboratory
laboratories.specialization: Life support systems, protective gear for fighter pilots and submariners.

laboratories.name: Defence Food Research Laboratory
laboratories.specialization: Food technology, preservation, and specialized rations for troops in extreme environments.

laboratories.name: Defence Institute of Physiology and Allied Sciences
laboratories.specialization: Human performance optimization in extreme high-altitude and desert environments.

clusters.focus: Nurturing cutting-edge disruptive technologies through independent young scientist teams under 35 years of age.

laboratories.name: DYSL - Artificial Intelligence
laboratories.specialization: Artificial intelligence, computer vision, and machine learning for defense applications.

laboratories.name: DYSL - Quantum Technologies
laboratories.specialization: Secure quantum communication and quantum sensors.

laboratories.name: DYSL - Cognitive Technologies
laboratories.specialization: Human-machine interaction, cognitive workload analysis, and adaptive systems.

laboratories.name: DYSL - Smart Materials
laboratories.specialization: Advanced smart materials and adaptive structural metamaterials.

laboratories.name: DYSL - Asymmetric Technologies
laboratories.specialization: Unconventional warfare solutions and disruptive asymmetric defense tech.

major_weapons_and_platforms.name: Agni-V
major_weapons_and_platforms.key_feature: 3-stage solid fuel canisterized launch system providing rapid deployment capability.

major_weapons_and_platforms.name: Tejas (LCA)
major_weapons_and_platforms.developed_by: ADA & DRDO labs in partnership with HAL
major_weapons_and_platforms.status: Active service in Indian Air Force (No. 45 Flying Daggers squadron)
major_weapons_and_platforms.key_feature: Tailless compound delta wing design with advanced digital Fly-By-Wire control and glass cockpit.

major_weapons_and_platforms.name: Uttam AESA Radar
major_weapons_and_platforms.status: Selected for Tejas Mk-1A and Mk-2 fighter jets
major_weapons_and_platforms.key_feature: Fully indigenous solid-state TR modules capable of simultaneous tracking of up to 50 targets.

major_weapons_and_platforms.name: BrahMos
major_weapons_and_platforms.type: Supersonic Cruise Missile (World's fastest operational cruise missile)
major_weapons_and_platforms.developed_by: BrahMos Aerospace (Joint venture between DRDO, India & NPOM, Russia)
major_weapons_and_platforms.status: Operational across Indian Army, Navy, and Air Force (Sukhoi Su-30MKI platform)
major_weapons_and_platforms.key_feature: Fire-and-forget trajectory with sea-skimming capability and high kinetic energy impact.

major_weapons_and_platforms.name: Pinaka MBRL
major_weapons_and_platforms.status: Operational in Indian Army (Exported to international allies like Armenia)
major_weapons_and_platforms.key_feature: Fires a salvo of 12 high-explosive rockets in 44 seconds, destroying target area of 3.9 sq km.

major_weapons_and_platforms.name: TAPAS-BH-201 (Rustom-II)
major_weapons_and_platforms.key_feature: Satellite-controlled real-time ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance) payload capability.

major_weapons_and_platforms.name: Akash SAM System
major_weapons_and_platforms.status: Operational in Indian Army & Air Force
major_weapons_and_platforms.key_feature: Guided by Rajendra 3D Phased Array Radar; capable of engaging multiple air targets simultaneously.

major_weapons_and_platforms.name: Astra Mk-1
major_weapons_and_platforms.status: Inducted into Indian Air Force (Sukhoi Su-30MKI, Tejas)
major_weapons_and_platforms.key_feature: All-weather day/night interceptor with smokeless rocket motor and active RF seeker.
